features.voiceDnaSub: Three spoken words become a one-of-a-kind acoustic signature. We match resonance, not faces.
features.elementSub: Discover your element and see which bonds run deepest — chemistry you can actually measure.

hero.title: Welcome to ourchemistry
hero.body: Swipe-free and photo-free. Use the arrow keys or the dock below to travel between worlds. When you are ready, save your spark on the waitlist.

features.title: The Science
features.body: Five pillars power every match. Read each card, then step into the Bond Lab to feel the global charge build.

bond.title: Bond Lab
bond.body: Drag the two atoms together. Every sign-up adds to the global charge. Reach 100 percent and the first spark lights up worldwide.

voice.title: Voice DNA
voice.body: Say any three words. We turn your voice into a unique sigil, processed on your device and never uploaded.

quiz.title: Element Quiz
quiz.body: Answer three quick questions to discover your element, then share it or match with a complementary one.

waitlist.title: The Waitlist
waitlist.body: Enter your email to reserve your place. Core chemistry is always free, and inviting friends moves you up the list.

faq.title: Good Questions
faq.body: Tap any question to expand it. Everything about launch, pricing and privacy lives here.

login.title: Welcome back
login.sub: Sign in to keep your spark safe across devices
login.privacy: Voice-first, photo-free. We never sell your data.
